parsed.explanation: The function `read_record` allows any authenticated actor to access a record if the `owner_id` is present, regardless of whether the actor is the actual owner of the record. Target category: access_control
Threat model: The session actor and records are trusted. The caller chooses record_id. Only the owner of the requested record may receive it. Login, role and tenant membership grant no exception. A missing or unauthorized record returns None.
<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    owner = records.get(record_id, {}).get("owner_id")
    snapshot = dict(records)
    row = snapshot.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    return row if actor["authenticated"] and owner is not None else None
